adds.rationale: Swap speculative reactor-vendor exposure for producing nuclear-fuel-cycle exposure: Cameco closed its $7.9B acquisition of Westinghouse Electric with Brookfield and is capturing record contracting as uranium and UF6 conversion prices hit new highs, a cleaner buildup-phase play on the same AI-driven nuclear demand thesis than the now-broken SMR position.

news_evidence.summary: Cameco and Brookfield complete $7.9B acquisition of Westinghouse Electric Company (regulatory approval Nov 3, close Nov 7)
Cameco raises 2023 consolidated revenue outlook on record contracting and rising uranium/UF6 conversion prices amid tightening nuclear fuel market

adds.rationale: Adds autonomous/unmanned-systems robotics exposure alongside industrial-automation holding ROK, and doubles as a geopolitical-rearmament play as global military spending rises amid the Israel-Gaza war and continuing Ukraine conflict; AeroVironment's fiscal Q2 2024 print shows the buildup phase is already converting to revenue.

news_evidence.summary: AeroVironment reports fiscal Q2 2024 (quarter ended Oct 28, 2023) revenue of $180.8M, up 62% YoY, funded backlog $487.0M, net income up 366% YoY
Israel's monthly defense spending surged over 200% from pre-war levels to $4.7B by December 2023, part of a broader global rearmament backdrop supporting unmanned-systems demand

removes.rationale: Thesis breach: NuScale's flagship, first-of-a-kind Carbon Free Power Project (the proof point for near-term SMR commercial deployment) was mutually terminated with UAMPS for lack of subscribers, and the stock hit an all-time low right after a weak Q3 print — the near-term SMR buildup case this position represented has stalled.

news_evidence.summary: UAMPS and NuScale Power agree to terminate the Carbon Free Power Project (CFPP) at Idaho National Laboratory, citing insufficient subscription
SMR shares fall to an all-time low of $1.81 immediately following Q3 2023 earnings, compounding an October short-seller report the company called inaccurate

rationale_overall: Net effect: the watchlist grows from 15 to 16 tickers, still well under the 24 cap. Nuclear exposure rotates from a broken near-term SMR deployment story into a producing uranium/fuel-cycle name (Cameco) riding the same structural nuclear-demand buildup with a cleaner commercial footing. Robotics exposure broadens from pure industrial automation (ROK) into autonomous/unmanned systems (AeroVironment), which also captures the geopolitical rearmament wave without over-stacking that bucket. AI mega-caps, RKLB, IONQ, ISRG, FRO, ROK, ITA, LMT, GD, and SPY are all kept unchanged: each has fresh Q4 2023 evidence of intact or strengthening thesis and none shows a crest signal yet, so no AI-bucket trims are proposed this quarter.
